message_source_quote: Inspired by the white-bear steering paper (Raman et al., 2026), but uses entirely self-written prompts with different concepts and carrier sentences. The vectors and the finding that the stance direction transfers to an independent prompt set are new to this submission.
writeup_source_quote: comes from the white-bear steering paper (Raman et al., 2026), which used WSB's directed_modulation pairs.
rationale: Both documents credit the white-bear steering paper (Raman et al., 2026) as the origin of the concept-agnostic stance-direction idea, and both describe the same novelty claim: that the direction generalizes to self-written prompts with non-target concepts and different carrier sentences rather than depending on WSB's directed_modulation items. The numbers (pass@10 0.7941, scale 1.07, read-only 0.44, context-only 0.15, dose curve shape) and the overall framing match closely, with no material addition, omission, or misstatement in either direction.
